'''Veil One''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Cyborg/Legends|Cyborg]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. Along with cyborgs [[Veil Two]] and [[Veil Three]], the three presented themselves as a single entity called "[[The Veil (Nar Shaddaa)|The Veil]]" to the [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] underworld. Around [[3640 BBY]] the Veil took control over the production of the [[CN-12 sensor chip]] from the [[Cult of the Screaming Blade]]. When [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], who owned the Cult, approached the Veil for the CN-12, the Veil offered the chip in exchange for the leadership of the Cult.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Veil One appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Nar Shaddaa.
